issues.explanation: Public $remember holds user input but has no validation rule, while every other user-supplied Livewire property is validated.
Store validates three fields inline instead of using a Form Request as the conventions prescribe once rules grow beyond one or two fields.
Forgot-password email uses email:rfc while login, register and reset use email:rfc,strict, a weaker and inconsistent validation.

conventions.evidence: Livewire uses #[Validate]+validate(), views use route() and plain wire:model, docs/CHANGELOG updated; minor gaps: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:300 $remember has no Validate rule, app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:182 validates 3 fields inline instead of a Form Request

readability.evidence: Small focused methods with PHPDoc (e.g. app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:302, app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:406), clear names, consistent Blade/Bulma structure, no dead code

requirements.evidence: Login strict email + auth.failed/auth.throttle + regenerate + intended home (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:294,320,328,339); Register strict+unique + Password::defaults + confirmed + transliterate register|ip key + Registered + login (app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:387,402,419,432,438); logout invalidate+regenerateToken (app/Http/Controllers/LogoutController.php:136-139); home auth+verified (routes/web.php:1119); forgot always passwords.sent + throttle:6,1 (routes/web.php:1096, app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetLinkController.php:245); reset single name=email + remember_token rotation + PasswordReset (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:191); MustVerifyEmail + signed verify with 403 on tamper (app/Models/User.php:470, routes/web.php:1111); pt_BR locale pins + ui.php keys + route() redirects

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves auth/localization: routes, Livewire, controllers, views, lang, phpunit locale pins, .env.example; CHANGELOG.md:26 and docs/business-rules.md:518 are docs-sync required by conventions, no unrelated features

security.evidence: Server-side validation everywhere with {{ }} escaping; session regenerate (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:339) and invalidate+regenerateToken on logout; per-email+IP lockout (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:348); signed+throttled verify via base EmailVerificationRequest (app/Http/Requests/Auth/EmailVerificationRequest.php:8); remember_token rotation Str::random(60) (app/Http/Controllers/NewPasswordController.php:193); $fillable guard on User

simplicity.evidence: Reuses Password::defaults (app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:491), base EmailVerificationRequest, Password::reset/sendResetLink, route() helpers; three tiny invokable verification controllers instead of new abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Auth/LoginTest.php, RegisterTest.php, PasswordResetTest.php, EmailVerificationTest.php, HomeTest.php, LogoutTest.php, AuthConfigurationTest.php cover happy path, validation failures, authenticated-cannot-submit, tampered-id/hash/unsigned 403, cross-email token reuse, throttle 429, and no-mail-on-unknown-email

review.summary: Session auth with Livewire login/register, logout, forgot/reset password and verified-only home is fully implemented with pt-BR localization and rate limiting. Tests are thorough and no security flaws were found; only minor convention nits remain, so approve with nits.
